notes.title: Official Apology Notice from No.9
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

This is the official apology notice from The Ninth Museum.

Firstly, we deeply apologize for the bugs and issues that occurred during the initial launch of the game, and have quickly completed all feedback bug fixes. If you still encounter any problems, please join our official group chat for feedback.

Secondly, based on player feedback, we have adjusted the pace of the early stages of the game to enable players to have faster access to explaining cards, optimize automated business processes, and avoid tedious explanations.

Thirdly, we are actively addressing the issue of adapting the Steam Deck controller. If there are no other bugs that need to be fixed, it is expected to be completed within one week; If there are other bugs, it will take at least half a month. We will complete the adaptation as soon as possible.

Fourthly, we sincerely apologize again for the localization translation errors reported by players in foreign regions, especially in English speaking areas. This issue has been highly valued by us, and the review and correction of localized content will be carried out simultaneously. After completion, an announcement will be issued.

Thank you to all players for their attention and support! We will continue to optimize the game and bring a better gaming experience to everyone.

Sincerely,
The Ninth Museum Team

notes.title: 2025.2.10Update
notes.notes:
We're very sorry that you encountered some issues when the game was first launched. We've fixed them in a timely manner and, based on everyone's feedback, made appropriate adjustments to the early - game pacing. Now players can access the explanation signs more quickly, which facilitates your understanding of the automated business operation and avoids consecutive and boring explanations.

We'll correct the localization issues as soon as possible. We apologize for the unpleasant experience we've brought to you.

notes.title: The 9th Museum is now on sale
notes.notes:
This is a game that simulates business operations and mild rogue! The game takes place in an era of human civilization's demise, and you will be reborn in a magical civilization from the ashes! Running an 'Old World' museum. 

In this game, you will be able to experience:
♥ Free construction of museums
——Rich furniture system, diverse styles for you to choose from
♥ Cultural relic restoration
——Collecting fragments of cultural relics and restoring them, passing on the torch from generation to generation, is a work that will last for generations
♥ simulation of operation
——Reasonably plan routes and skills to obtain more rewards and unlock scale
♥ Material production
——Produce distinctive furniture and handicrafts to assist in the construction and operation of museums
♥ Adventure mode
——Mild rogue night exploration, excavating materials and artifacts
♥ Featured roles
——Featured NPCs assist in management, and the simulation journey is rich and colorful

The discount lasts for 14 days, looking forward to your feedback!
The bug/suggestion feedback channel will continue to be open, welcome to join the group
You can also contact us by email, send us your file and describe the problem, and we will reply and handle it as soon as possible!
We will continue to optimize and update in the future.

notes.title: "Museum No.9" postponement announcement
notes.notes:
I'm sorry to inform you of a message.

According to the original plan to release "Museum Nine" on January 17, but due to some uncontrollable reasons, the game could not be launched on time, and it has been postponed.

The game is expected to be released 1-2 weeks later than originally scheduled, so please wait.

At present, the studio is actively contacting Steam customer service to approve the new release time and submission time.

We would also like to thank you for your anticipation and support of the game, and we are sorry that the game cannot be launched as scheduled. When the game has been successfully reviewed and the launch time is confirmed, we will notify you as soon as possible!

notes.title: The demo version is coming to an end, and the release date is set for January 17
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your support of Museum Nine during this time, and thank you for your willingness to play, rate, feedback, and add to your wishlist.

The demo will end on December 16, 2024, and we have carefully reviewed the suggestions and feedback received during this period to make improvements.

Meantime! Our official version is also confirmed to be released on January 17, 2025!

We look forward to seeing you again in the official version, tank you!
